book.name: GÁLATAS
book.title: ISCARTA NAJ SAN PABLO YATO TET MACTA AYXACO YUL ISKꞌAB COMAM BEY GALACIA

content: Ay hunxa yechel chiwalan teyet. Kꞌinalo hunu nichꞌan unin chischah ismajul tet ismam, caw yahawil chuco yin̈ tzet ay ismam tuꞌ, yaj xin yet nichꞌanto caw maẍto yip yin̈ tzet chiakꞌlax ismajulo tuꞌ, to hacaꞌ to chejab yehi.
Yet nichꞌanto ay mac chitan̈eni, yeb xin ilbiltopaxo huneꞌ ismajul tuꞌ masanto yet chꞌapni istiempohal bay halbilcano yu ismam, cat yoccano yahawo yin̈ ismajul tuꞌ.
Caw xin hac tuꞌ je han̈on̈ tiꞌ; yet yalan̈tocanoj ayon̈ayo yalan̈ yip sunil tzet chal anma.
Haxa yet yijni isba yapni istiempohal xin, yaniti Comam Dios Iscꞌahol, pitzcꞌana yin̈ huneꞌ ix ix yalan̈ yip isley naj Moisés.
Hul Comam yun̈e con̈yinilo yalan̈ ley, yeb yun̈e con̈ischahni Comam Dios yuninaloj.

Yun̈e isyenilo Comam tato caw yuninalxa Comam jehi, yuxin yati Comam Yespíritu Iscꞌahol yul janma. Yu Yespíritu Comam tuꞌ yuxinto chijal tet Comam Dios yin̈ sunil janma hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Mam,” con̈chi, yin̈ caw sunil cocꞌul.
Wal tinan̈ xin, matxa chejabo jehi, to caw yuninalxa Comam jehi. Yu huneꞌ tuꞌ xin, caw el yin̈ iscꞌul Comam Dios yakꞌni huneꞌ comatan, yaj yu Comam Jesucristo, Iscꞌahol Comam tuꞌ.
Caw oc yin̈ iscꞌul naj Pablo yin̈ ebnaj ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Jesucristo
Yet yalan̈to tuꞌ yet maẍto cheyohtan̈elo Comam Dios, caw chejab heyehico tet huntekꞌan chal anma diosalil. Wal xin, caw mach dioso huntekꞌan tuꞌ.

Tinan̈ xin, heyohtaxa Comam Dios sicꞌlebil, chiwalpaxojan teyet tato caw ohtabilexxapaxo yu Comam. ¿Tzet yin̈ yuxinto chexmeltzopaxto yin̈ huntekꞌanxa nan cuybanilehal caw mach tꞌin̈ano yehicoj, cat heyocpaxo ischejabo hunelxa?
Walex hex tiꞌ, cheyije kꞌin̈ chiecꞌtzelax yin̈ isbi tzꞌayic, yeb yin̈ isbi ixahaw, yeb yet chishelni isba tiempo, yeb kꞌin̈ chiecꞌtzelax yin̈ hunun habil.
¡Caw chioc yin̈ incꞌulan yet chinnanitijan, wakꞌa tato caw nabn̈e quinmunlahan texol!

Hex wuẍtaj, hex wanab, caw chiwalan teyet, lahanojab cheyute henabal hacaꞌ innabalan, yuto yet wecꞌan texol wute innabalan hacaꞌ hex. Wal xin matolo yu ay hunu istxꞌojal heyute win̈an yuxin hac tuꞌ walnitojan teyet, machoj.
Wal xin caw heyohtaxa ta hayet babelal, yet walnicꞌojan cuybanile yet colbanile teyet caw yaꞌayinan yu huneꞌ yabil.

Haꞌ huneꞌ yabil tuꞌ, caw ilwebal teyin̈, yajaꞌ mach quinhehincꞌuln̈ehan, mach xin quinheman̈cꞌotojan yu huneꞌ yabil tuꞌ. Wal xin caw hacaꞌ hunu ischejab Comam Dios satcan̈, hac tuꞌ yu quinhechahnihan, yeb hacaꞌ caw Comam Jesucristo.
¿Tzet yin̈ yuxin matxa huneꞌ tzalahilal tuꞌ yul heyanma tinan̈? Chiwalan huneꞌ iscꞌulal tiꞌ teyin̈, hex tiꞌ caw heyoche heyilti isbakꞌ hesat heyakꞌni wetan yu iscꞌulchꞌanil hecꞌul win̈an.
Wal tinan̈ xin, ¿tom ayco inhowalan teyin̈ yet chiwalnitojan isyelal tiꞌ teyet?
Haꞌ huntekꞌan anma chexmonten tuꞌ, caw ayco yanma ebnaj teyin̈, yajaꞌ xin caw mach cꞌulo nabil teyin̈ yu ebnaj. Ton̈e choche ebnaj quexyikꞌalo coxolan̈ yun̈e heyanico heyanma yin̈ ebnaj.

Caw cꞌul janico anma yin̈ cocꞌul, yajaꞌ tan̈e cꞌul chiconaco yin̈, yeb tato istoholal nabil ju. Aytam sakꞌal ta hac tuꞌ chinheyutehan yin̈ sunilbal tiempo, maẍn̈etaj yet ayinan tecꞌatan̈ chinheyanicojan yin̈ hecꞌul.

Hex tiꞌ caw hacaꞌ wuninalan heyehi, lan̈an yecꞌyaꞌ wanmahan hunelxa heyu, hacaꞌ hunu ix ix chiaben isyaꞌil yet chiwatxꞌi iscꞌul. Yaj mach chisbej wabenan huneꞌ isyaꞌtajil tiꞌ masanto chiwatxꞌicanico Comam Jesucristo teyin̈.
Majal ayinan texol tinan̈ yun̈e insaynihan hunuxa tzet chiyu intzotelan teyet. Wal xin caw cꞌaynajilo incꞌulan teyin̈.
Cuybanil yin̈ istzotiꞌal ix Agar yeb xin ix Sara
Maquex chexmeltzopaxto heyijen tzet chal isley naj Moisés heyalni, halwe wetan: ¿Tom caw maẍto bay cheyabe tzet chal huneꞌ ley tuꞌ?
Chal yul Yum Comam Dios tato ay cawan̈ iscꞌahol icham Abraham; huneꞌ naj yeb ix Agar, ix chejab; huneꞌxa naj xin yeb ix Sara, ix caw yixal icham Abraham tuꞌ; ix Sara tuꞌ mach chejabo ix.

Naj Ismael, yunin ix Agar, mach cꞌaybalo cꞌule yu ispitzcꞌa naj. Wal naj Isaac, yunin ix Sara, cꞌaybalcꞌule yu ispitzcꞌa naj yu Comam Dios, yuto caw ixnamxa ix yet ispitzcꞌa naj, yun̈e yijni isba tzet haltebilcano yu Comam Dios yin̈ naj.

Haꞌ cawan̈ ebix tuꞌ, yechel cabeb istrato Comam Dios ye ebix. Ix Agar, ix mebaꞌ yehi, yechel huneꞌ trato iswatxꞌe Comam Dios bey iswiꞌ witz Sinaí, yuxinto sunil macta ayco yin̈ huneꞌ trato tuꞌ, hacaꞌ ta pitzcꞌana yu yoc chejaboj.

Ix Agar tuꞌ, yechel istrato Comam Dios yakꞌ tet naj Moisés bey witz Sinaí yul ismajul Arabia, yechelpaxo con̈ob Jerusalén ye ix. Anma ay yul con̈ob Jerusalén tuꞌ, ayco yalan̈ ley akꞌbil bey iswiꞌ witz Sinaí.

Wal huneꞌxa istrato Comam Dios xin, yechel ix Sara yixal icham Abraham yehi, yuto mach chejabo ye ix yalan̈ ley. Yajaꞌ wal huneꞌ Jerusalén ay yul satcan̈, mach ayoco yalan̈ chejbanile, han̈on̈ tiꞌ xin yuninal jehi.
Yuto chal yul Yum Comam Dios:

content.text: Hach ix machi hawunin, yeb maẍticꞌa chil yin̈ hunu yunin, tzalahan̈. Awan̈ yin̈ tzalahilal hach maẍticꞌa hawohtajo isyaꞌtajil ispitzcꞌa niẍte unin, yuto haꞌ ix ix hinbilcanoj caw txꞌiꞌalto yunin ix sata ix ay yichamil, ẍiayoj.

content: Hex wuẍtaj, hex wanab, hex tiꞌ hacaꞌ naj Isaac heyehi, uninale halbilcano yu Comam Dios ta chipitzcꞌahi.
Yet payxa tuꞌ naj mach cꞌaybalcꞌule yu ispitzcꞌahi, caw caj yil naj naj pitzcꞌa yu yip Comam Espíritu Santo. Hacaꞌ yu iscajlax naj Isaac yu naj Ismael, hac tuꞌ xin yepaxo tinan̈.

Yajaꞌ ¿tzet ẍi yul Yum Comam Dios? Wal xin chal hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Tzumbeto ix chejab yeb yunin, yuto naj yunin ix tuꞌ, caw mach chu yakꞌni cabo isba naj yin̈ tzettaj chischah naj yunin ix mach chejaboj,” ẍiayoj.
Yuxin, hex wuẍtaj, hex wanab, wal han̈on̈ tiꞌ mach yuninalo ix chejab jehi, to yuninal ix mach chejaboj.
